subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should this issue be fixed as a narrow `read` safe-fallback guard, adopted from the linked fork PR, or folded into broader document extraction/provider-native file support?
rationale: Current source proves the raw-binary read path remains, but choosing between a small unsupported-document fallback and richer document parsing changes core scope, dependency/security review needs, and overlap with open document attachment issues.

options.title: Narrow read fallback
options.body: Guard known binary document MIME types/extensions in the read tool and return a concise unsupported-file message without adding parsers.

options.title: Broader document extraction
options.body: Fold this into document extraction/provider-native file support so read can eventually return extracted content where supported.

options.title: Close linked PR direction
options.body: Reject the stale/conflicting fork PR and route parsing-only work to plugin/MCP or ClawHub paths while keeping this issue for the core fallback decision.

recommendation.title: Narrow read fallback
recommendation.body: Guard known binary document MIME types/extensions in the read tool and return a concise unsupported-file message without adding parsers.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest verified current history around Office path handling in the read wrapper, which is the likely decision boundary.
